reviews.title: Here’s the TRUTH
reviews.text:
Initial Impressions: 
Confusion & Forced Tutorials
Right out of the gate, the UX is frustrating. The app prompted me to match with someone immediately, but it was disguised as a mandatory tutorial. I spent my first few minutes just trying to figure out how to un-match and un-follow people I never intended to engage with. It feels like the app is trying to "fake" engagement numbers.

The Major Red Flag: Safety & Verification
The most concerning part is the absolute lack of age or profile verification. There is no ID check and seemingly no moderation. This creates a dangerous environment where minors could easily be contacted by older users without any safeguards in place. In 2025, this is unacceptable for any social platform, let alone one targeting "gamers."


Not a Gaming App—A Promotion Hub:
If you’re looking for gaming content, look elsewhere. A huge portion of the "community" posts are just people spamming links to non-gaming YouTube channels. It feels less like a place to meet a Player 2 and more like a billboard for low-quality self-promotion.

The "Bot" Problem & NSFW Content:
Within minutes, the feed becomes an endless scroll of "OnlyFans" and "Patreon" “Snapchat” advertisements disguised as gamer profiles. It is heavily bot-infested and dominated by scantily clad users looking for subscribers rather than actual social connection or gaming partners.

Verdict (So Far):
